The '''AF Double Strobe Shield Generator''' was a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] manufactured by [[Verdrellig]]. An AF Double Strobe Shield Generator was installed aboard the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].
